    "Recommendations align when they extend a specific recurring interest, such as a musical theme, artist, or practical repair task.",

    "Broadly related products recur without evidence of the task, compatible equipment, or specific interest needed to make them useful.",

  ],

    "Broad category, ecosystem, and genre similarity substitutes for a concrete reason to choose an item.",
    "Shared product type or collection format is treated as sufficient despite differences in function, musical style, or current need."

  "UNDERUSED_OR_MISSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Specific recent intent and repeated themes provide stronger choice signals than loosely related historical interactions.",
    "Compatibility, dimensions, quantities, and capabilities already owned determine whether a related product is actually useful.",
    "Fine distinctions in artist, style, story premise, and intended task determine which broadly relevant items users would choose now."
  ],
  "PRIMARY_FAILURE_MODE_AT_TOP_OF_LIST": "Top recommendations contain too many broadly plausible associations and redundant alternatives, leaving too few items with a specific, current reason for selection.",
